about: Isaac Bot brain exam. Multiple choice with facts, the way the new brain sees decisions. Each question comes from a real moment in the bot's runs (2026-11-25) or a rule the author gave. 'answer' is the best option; 'ok' lists acceptable second choices (half marks).

questions.situation: Room cleared. Isaac has 1 red heart left (of 3), no soul hearts. A single penny lies on the far side of a row of floor spikes; the only path to it crosses 2 spike tiles (each step on spikes = half a heart of damage). The exit door is open.

options.A: Walk over the spikes to get the penny
options.B: Skip the penny and go to the next room
options.D: Wait in the room for the spikes to go away

questions.why: A penny is worth almost nothing; at 1 heart, a full heart of spike damage kills you. Spikes can't be bombed away.

questions.situation: Room cleared. Isaac has 6 red hearts (full) and 2 soul hearts. A penny lies behind 1 spike tile (half a heart of damage to reach it). Coins: 2. The shop on this floor sells a 15-coin item.

options.A: Take half a heart of damage for the penny
options.B: Skip the penny
options.D: Use the only bomb on the wall next to it

questions.why: Even at full health, half a heart for 1 coin is a poor trade; acceptable only because health is plentiful.

questions.situation: Fight. Four Gapers (walking enemies) are trapped inside a ring of rocks. The ring's only gap, on the left side, is plugged by one poop. Isaac is outside the ring, top side. Bombs: 2.

options.A: Bomb a rock in the ring
options.B: Walk to the left side, line up with the poop and shoot it to open the gap, then shoot through the gap
options.D: Stand still and keep shooting at the rocks

questions.why: Tears break poop; bombs are scarce. Opening the gap gives a shooting lane for free.

questions.situation: Fight. A Horf (a floating head that does not move and spits a tear when Isaac is in line with it) sits in a one-square pocket in a wall of rocks. The only square with a clear straight line to it is directly below it, 3 squares down. Isaac is 2 squares to the right of that square.

options.A: Shoot diagonally from where he stands
options.B: Bomb the rocks around the Horf
options.C: Step into the clear column below it, shoot up, and sidestep when it spits

questions.why: Tears go in straight lines and rocks block them; stand in the one open lane, dodge its slow shots.

questions.situation: Fight. The only enemy left is an Eternal Fly (300 hp, cannot be damaged) that sits on top of a poop and does not move away from it. The room's doors are still closed.

options.A: Shoot the fly until it dies
options.B: Shoot the poop it is attached to
options.C: Use a bomb on the fly

questions.why: It can't be hurt; it's tied to the poop. Break the poop (the author's tip). Doors are closed, so leaving is impossible.

questions.situation: The room's doors are OPEN (room counts as cleared). A red spiked block (shows 100 hp) sits still near the middle; it slides when Isaac lines up with it and hurts on touch. Nothing else is in the room. The boss room door is on the opposite side.

options.A: Keep shooting the block until it dies
options.B: Walk to the boss door, keeping out of the block's row and column

questions.why: It can't be killed and doesn't need to be: the room is already cleared. Avoid its lines and move on.

questions.situation: Fight. Three Attack Flies (very light, 5 hp each, fly straight at Isaac, hurt on touch) are coming from the right. Isaac's tears push light enemies back when they hit. There is open floor on all sides.

options.A: Run away from the flies to the far corner
options.B: Face them and shoot right: each hit knocks them back and they die in two shots

questions.why: Flies are light (mass 3): tears knock them back, so holding ground and shooting is safe and fast. Running to a corner is how you get trapped.

questions.situation: Room cleared. A plain brown chest is walled in by rocks (no path). Isaac has 2 bombs and 0 keys. The next floor's boss is soon.

options.A: Use a bomb to reach the chest
options.B: Skip the chest

questions.why: A brown chest is usually a few coins or hearts: not worth one of only 2 bombs (budget: 5+ bombs for small loot). Tears don't break rocks.

questions.situation: Room cleared. A free item on a pedestal is walled in by rocks (no path). Isaac has 1 bomb.

options.A: Bomb the rocks and take the item
options.B: Skip it to save the bomb

questions.why: Items are the most valuable thing in a run: worth even the last bomb.

questions.situation: Floor fully explored except the boss. On Isaac's own map there is one empty square that touches 3 rooms he has visited, and it is not next to the boss room. Isaac has 4 bombs and full health.

options.A: Bomb the wall of one of the visited rooms facing that empty square
options.B: Go straight to the boss
options.C: Bomb random walls in the current room

questions.why: An empty square touching 3+ rooms (never the boss room) is the classic secret room spot; with 4 bombs it's worth one.

questions.situation: Floor explored. The only empty square touches just 2 known rooms. Isaac has 2 bombs.

options.A: Bomb a wall facing it
options.B: Go to the boss and keep the bombs
options.C: Use both bombs on two walls
options.D: Go back to the start room

questions.why: A 2-neighbour guess is weak; with only 2 bombs, save them (budget: 6+ bombs for weak guesses).

questions.situation: Room cleared, 2 red hearts left. The only unexplored door leads to a Curse Room (a door with spikes: walking through it costs half a heart each way). The boss room is reachable another way.

options.A: Go through the curse room door
options.B: Head to the boss instead

questions.why: Curse rooms cost health going in and out; at 2 hearts with the boss next, skip it.

questions.situation: Room cleared. Isaac already holds a pill in his pocket slot. Another pill lies on the floor. Walking over it swaps them (the old one drops).

options.A: Walk over the new pill
options.B: Leave it and move on

questions.why: With the slot full, picking it up only swaps them; the bot looped forever doing that once.

questions.situation: Room cleared. Two lit fireplaces stand between Isaac and the exit door; there is a path around them that is 3 squares longer. Touching a fire hurts.

options.A: Walk straight through the fires
options.B: Take the longer path around the fires
options.D: Wait for them to go out

questions.why: Fires hurt on touch (the batch review found 3 hits from them); a slightly longer path is free.

questions.situation: Fight. A Clotty left a red creep puddle on the floor between Isaac and the best firing spot. Standing in creep hurts. A slightly longer route around the puddle exists.

options.A: Walk through the creep
options.B: Go around the creep
options.C: Stand still in the creep and shoot

questions.why: Creep deals damage over time; never stand in it when a route around exists.

questions.situation: Fight. A Gaper (walks straight at Isaac, hurts on touch, normal weight) is chasing him. A 'firing spot' computed half a second ago is now right where the Gaper stands.

options.A: Walk to the firing spot anyway
options.B: Keep distance, line up with the Gaper and shoot while backing away into open space

questions.why: Chasers make planned spots stale; kiting in open space is the safe way (walking into the stale spot caused 3 hits).

questions.situation: Isaac just dropped a bomb next to a rock to open a path. The bomb explodes in about 1.5 seconds with a blast about 2 squares wide.

options.A: Stay next to the bomb to see if it worked
options.B: Move at least 3 squares away until it explodes

questions.why: Your own bomb hurts you; the bot once stood next to its own bomb.

questions.situation: Basement I. Explored: start room, 3 normal rooms. Unexplored: a door marked as a treasure room (free item) and the boss room door. Health full.

options.A: Go to the boss now
options.B: Go to the treasure room first, then the boss

questions.why: Treasure rooms give a free item; always take it before the boss.

questions.situation: Room cleared, about to enter the boss room. Isaac has half a red heart left, no soul hearts. He holds one pill he has never used before (its effect is unknown: some pills heal or raise stats, some hurt, e.g. 'Bad Trip' deals a full heart of damage if you have more than one heart, otherwise it heals). Coins 0.

options.A: Take the unknown pill now, it might heal
options.B: Keep the pill and fight the boss as is
options.C: Take the pill in the middle of the boss fight

questions.why: At half a heart, Bad Trip turns into a heal, and most other bad pills don't kill; the upside (healing/stat pills) beats the small risk. Keeping it is acceptable but wastes a chance.

questions.situation: Room cleared. A tinted rock (a rock with a faint X mark) sits in a corner; tinted rocks usually drop soul hearts or other loot when bombed. Isaac has 4 bombs and 2 of 3 red hearts.

options.A: Bomb the tinted rock
options.B: Ignore it
options.D: Bomb a normal rock next to it

questions.why: Tinted rocks are reliable loot (often soul hearts); with 4 bombs one is well spent. Tears don't break rocks.

questions.situation: In the shop with 15 coins. 1 red heart left of 3, next is the boss. For sale: a full red heart (3 coins), a key (5 coins), a bomb (5 coins), and a passive item that gives +0.5 damage (15 coins).

options.A: Buy the +0.5 damage item
options.B: Buy the heart, then the key and the bomb
options.C: Buy the heart only and save the rest
options.D: Buy the key and the bomb

questions.why: At 1 heart before a boss, healing comes first; a key and a bomb are flexible value. +0.5 damage doesn't help if you die.

questions.situation: A devil room appeared after the boss. Isaac has 4 red heart containers (all full) and 1 soul heart. On offer: Brimstone (a top-tier laser that replaces tears) for 2 red heart containers; or leave.

options.A: Take Brimstone for 2 heart containers
options.B: Leave it, keep the health
options.C: Take it only if he had 6 containers

questions.why: Brimstone is one of the strongest items in the game; with 4 containers, trading 2 still leaves a workable run. Bombing the statue spawns a fight.

questions.situation: Boss fight against Monstro (a big blob that leaps into the air and lands on where Isaac was, or hops and sprays a fan of tears). His shadow just appeared under Isaac: he is about to land there.

options.A: Keep shooting from the same spot
options.B: Move out from under the shadow right away, sideways, then shoot him when he lands
options.D: Place a bomb on the shadow

questions.why: The shadow marks the landing spot: move off it immediately; corners trap you against his tear fan.

questions.situation: Boss item room with two pedestals; taking one makes the other vanish. Option 1: 'Cricket's Head' (+0.5 damage and a big x1.5 damage multiplier). Option 2: 'Breakfast' (+1 red heart container). Isaac has 3 hearts, low damage.

options.A: Take Cricket's Head
options.B: Take Breakfast

questions.why: A damage multiplier is among the best upgrades for a weak run; one heart container is minor by comparison.

questions.situation: Room cleared. Isaac has 1 red heart left. A SOUL heart (adds a whole extra heart of protection) lies behind one spike tile (half a heart of damage to cross, once each way if there is no other way back).

options.A: Cross the spikes to get the soul heart
options.B: Skip it
options.D: Cross only if there is a way back without spikes

questions.why: In and out costs a full heart = death at 1 heart; one way only (half a heart) for a full soul heart is a net gain. Skipping is safe.

questions.situation: Isaac has 5 of 6 red hearts. A Curse Room (half a heart to enter, half a heart to leave) is next to him; it often holds a chest or pickups. No other rooms left except the boss.

options.A: Visit the curse room
options.B: Skip it and go to the boss

questions.why: With nearly full health a full heart for a chest/pickups is a fair trade; skipping is also fine.

questions.situation: Fight. A Horf (stands still, spits a tear when lined up with Isaac) is in the open on the left; three Attack Flies (light, fly at Isaac, die in 2 hits, get knocked back by tears) are coming from the right.

options.A: Kill the Horf first while the flies chase
options.B: Turn and kill the flies first (they knock back and die fast), then the Horf

questions.why: The fast chasers are the immediate threat and die in seconds; the Horf stays put and only fires when lined up.

questions.situation: Isaac has exactly 1 key. Two locked things on the floor: a locked treasure room door (free item inside) and a golden chest in the current room (random pickups, sometimes an item).

options.A: Open the golden chest
options.B: Save the key for the treasure room
options.C: Use the key on whichever is closer

questions.why: A guaranteed item beats a chest that only sometimes has one.
